verdict.rationale: Riveter documents webhook delivery: pass `webhook_url` when starting a run, and it POSTs the full results to your URL on run.completed, run.stopped and run.finished events. Its docs also explicitly recommend webhooks over polling. Scope is narrow, though: subscriptions are per-run callbacks covering only run lifecycle events, not a standing account-level subscription. Missing for 10: account-level webhook subscription/management, event types beyond run lifecycle, documented signature verification and delivery retries, independent hands-on corroboration.
